title: Differential analysis of gene regulation at transcript resolution with RNA-seq

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Differential analysis of gene regulation at transcript resolution with RNA-seq》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Differential analysis of gene and transcript expression using high-throughput RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) is complicated by several sources of measurement variability and poses numerous statistical challenges.

evidence.text: Differential analysis of gene and transcript expression using high-throughput RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) is complicated by several sources of measurement variability and poses numerous statistical challenges.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Differential analysis of gene regulation at transcript resolution with RNA-seq》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We present Cuffdiff 2, an algorithm that estimates expression at transcript-level resolution and controls for variability evident across replicate libraries.

evidence.text: We present Cuffdiff 2, an algorithm that estimates expression at transcript-level resolution and controls for variability evident across replicate libraries.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Differential analysis of gene regulation at transcript resolution with RNA-seq》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】We demonstrate the accuracy of our approach through differential analysis of lung fibroblasts in response to loss of the developmental transcription factor HOXA1, which we show is required for lung fibroblast and HeLa cell cycle progression.

evidence.text: We demonstrate the accuracy of our approach through differential analysis of lung fibroblasts in response to loss of the developmental transcription factor HOXA1, which we show is required for lung fibroblast and HeLa cell cycle progression.
